messages:
maria.g: FYI I opened a PR to refresh the Optimize toolkit examples — swapping the old monolithic quant example for a small matrix of 4/8-bit profiles and adding an SDK v2 batching snippet that demonstrates prefix caching. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4876 :eyes:
kevin.p: Nice. Can you call out the migration steps for teams that rely on legacy `batcher` config? Last time people accidentally lost KV caching when they upgraded.
maria.g: Good call. I added a short migration section at the bottom — shows the three-line mapping and a quick sanity check command. Snippet I added:
```
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.environ.get('REDWOOD_KEY'))
resp = client.batch.generate([
  {"prompt": "summarize: ..."},
  {"prompt": "summarize: ..."}
], batch_config={"max_batch_size": 8, "kv_prefetch": True})
```
kevin.p: That `kv_prefetch` flag is important — could we also show how to disable prefix caching for low-memory devices?
alex.r: I left an inline example for that: set `kv_prefetch: False` and enable `prefetch_whitelist: ["short_prompts"]` in the config. But I wonder if the phrasing is clear enough for non-Infra folks.
maria.g: Added an explicit note: "If you run into OOMs, try kv_prefetch: false and fall back to q8_0 profile for long contexts". Also added a short table explaining quant profiles: q4_0, q4_1, q8_0, q8_1 and tradeoffs.
sam.k: Heads-up — samplegen CI failed on the new SDK snippet because the test harness expects `client.generate` not `client.batch.generate`. We should keep one minimal compatibility snippet for people still on the old call.
maria.g: Ugh, thanks Sam. I'll add the compatibility snippet and push.
docs-bot: GitHub PR opened by maria.g — redwood-inference/docs#4876 (optkit: update quant matrix + sdk v2 batching + migration notes)
kevin.p: Also noticed one broken link in the migration section pointing to /optimize/old-batcher — 404. Can someone fix to /optimize/migration/batcher-v2 ?
alex.r: I'll patch that in the PR. Also added a short test case suggestion: run 10 prompt reps with `--trace` and check token-level latency doesn't spike >2x across 1k tokens.
maria.g: Perfect. After Sam's CI fix and Alex's link patch, please thumbs up if you think this is good to merge. :thumbsup:
sam.k: CI green now. I left one nit on wording.
kevin.p: Read through, looks good to me. :shipit:
maria.g: Thanks all — I'll merge in ~30m unless someone requests a blocker. If you want a live walk-through, I'll open a 15m huddle.
alex.r: No blockers from me, merge away.
maria.g: Merge done. Changelog entry added under Optimize v0.9 -> docs: "clarify kv/caching + add quant profile matrix and SDK v2 batching examples"
docs-bot: PR redwood-inference/docs#4876 merged by maria.g
